mechanism: Keep one information interface and spatial grid fixed while a visible selector chooses one item at a time. Each selection must update the title, concise attributes and one large live viewport together; the selected subject then performs one short behavior that proves the new state before the next choice.

invariants.rule: Keep one selector grid, one data zone and one live viewport fixed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Moving interface regions make updates difficult to compare.

invariants.rule: Show one visible selector action before every content change.
Update title, attributes and live subject as one synchronized state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Partial updates make the catalog feel broken.

invariants.rule: Give each selected subject one short defining behavior.
invariants.purpose: Proves more than a static thumbnail.
invariants.ablation_failure: Idle subjects do not justify a live viewport.

invariants.rule: End on a held complete state with selector and selected subject both visible.
invariants.purpose: Lets the viewer verify the final choice.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cutting away immediately removes the proof relation.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the exact source grid and cursor path
